title: Barber's team brought in for DoD; 59+ agencies not coordinating at Picatinny

tellings.quote: There were over 59 local law enforcement entities working not coordinating there. We had FBI, we had DoD, we had private partners

plain: Jake Barber, who says he helped recover a UFO by helicopter, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that in December 2024 his team was brought in for the Department of Defense at Picatinny Arsenal, a military site in New Jersey. He says more than 59 local police agencies were working there without coordinating, alongside the FBI, the Defense Department and private partners, which would point to a large and messy response to something happening at the site.
